store_listing.title: Kavya Setu: Poetry & Shayari
store_listing.short_description: Multilingual poetry & shayari in Hindi, Odia, English with Gemini AI & audio.
store_listing.full_description:
Kavya Setu (काव्य सेतु / କାବ୍ୟ ସେତୁ) is a celebration of Indian poetic heritage, bridging classical verses in Hindi, Urdu, and Odia with modern AI-assisted composition and authentic acoustic audio recitations.

✨ KEY FEATURES:

• Curated Multilingual Verses: Explore thousands of timeless couplets and poems from legends like Mirza Ghalib, Allama Iqbal, Ramdhari Singh Dinkar, Jaun Elia, and Odia masters like Kantakabi Laxmikanta Mohapatra.
• Authentic Tarannum & Audio Recitations: Immerse yourself in spoken verses and melodic Tarannum recitals with ambient Indian classical sitar and tanpura accompaniments.
• Gemini AI Poetry Studio: Compose custom Ghazals, Nazms, Haikus, Dohas, and Mukt Chhand in Hindi, Urdu, and Odia. Includes real-time metrical breakdown of Bahr, Radif, and Kafiya rhymes.
• Calligraphy Card Studio: Customize aesthetic poetry cards with traditional parchment, royal velvet, and midnight obsidian textures. Export high-resolution cards directly for social sharing.
• Offline Vault & Personal Bookmarks: Save favorite verses, organize by poetic themes, and mark your reading progress with consecutive streak tracking.
• Virtual Mehfil & Mushaira: Experience live poetic symposiums with Wah-Wah audience reactions and Sher-baazi rhyming challenges.
• Home Screen Daily Widget & Push Reminders: Start every morning with a handpicked couplet on your home screen or through gentle morning notifications.

🛡️ PRIVACY & COMPLIANCE:
• Completely offline-first vault for saved verses.
• Respects user privacy; no invasive tracking or unnecessary device permissions.
• Content curated for cultural and educational enrichment.
